cohort: 73 pregnant women with early symptoms of COVID-19 out of 20193 women of childbearing age in Ardabil province from March 2020 to August 2020
finding: Pregnant women do not show different clinical presentations compared to non-pregnant women of childbearing age when infected with SARS-CoV-2, but complications of pregnancy, such as preterm delivery and stillbirth, are more common in infected pregnant women.
gest_age: Third trimester in 61.6% of the cohort
